## Re-taking these

```
PORT=8152 go run ./cmd/server                       # a server with data in it
node docs/guides/capture-screenshots.js --token "<session token>" --base http://localhost:8152
```

`--only sidebar,setup-menu` re-takes just those. `--theme dark` captures the
dark theme instead. See the header of `capture-screenshots.js` for the rest.

**These are generated.** Do not retouch them by hand — the next capture run
overwrites the file. If a shot is wrong, fix the screen or the shot definition.
